name: @thaarei/workspace

scripts.check: biome ci . && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:python && pnpm check:deploy && pnpm check:auth:cli
scripts.check:contracts: node scripts/module-registry.mjs --check && turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/turnstile-contracts --filter=@thaarei/dms-contracts --filter=@thaarei/control-plane-contracts && node scripts/generate-control-plane-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-turnstile-time-zones.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-turnstile-onboarding-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-user-management-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-module-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-module-transition-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dms-auth-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dms-openapi.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dms-operator-contract.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-dms-work-contract.mjs --check && pnpm --filter @thaarei/dms-processing exec uv run --locked python ../../scripts/check-dms-contracts.py && node scripts/generate-dms-evidence.mjs --check
scripts.check:boundaries: turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/dms-contracts --filter=@thaarei/turnstile-contracts --filter=@thaarei/dms-client --filter=@thaarei/control-plane-contracts --filter=@thaarei/deployment-control --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog && depcruise apps/thaarei-control-plane/src apps/dms-api/src apps/turnstile-api/src apps/turnstile-web/src packages/installation-engine/src packages/module-catalog/src packages/deployment-control/src packages/control-plane-contracts/src packages/dms-client/src packages/dms-contracts/src packages/turnstile-contracts/src --config tooling/dependency-rules/config.cjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/dev-container.test.mjs scripts/module-delivery.test.mjs scripts/module-registry.test.mjs scripts/installation-intent.test.mjs && turbo run test
scripts.test:integration: turbo run test:integration && pnpm test:database && pnpm test:storage
scripts.release:modules: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog... && node scripts/module-delivery.mjs
scripts.test:images:modules: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog... && node scripts/test-selected-module-images.mjs
scripts.installation:prepare: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog... --filter=@thaarei/deployment-control... && node scripts/prepare-installation.mjs
scripts.test:browser:modules: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog... --filter=@thaarei/deployment-control... && node scripts/test-selected-module-images.mjs --access
scripts.module:cutover: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/deployment-control... && node scripts/module-cutover.mjs
scripts.test:module:cutover: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/deployment-control... && node scripts/test-module-cutover.mjs
scripts.docs:module-transitions: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/module-catalog... && node scripts/generate-module-transition-openapi.mjs
scripts.release:installation: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/installation-engine... && node scripts/installation-release.mjs
scripts.test:installation:engine: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@thaarei/installation-engine... && node scripts/test-installation-engine.mjs
